title: Autonomy against alignment: how much rope, and who decides

videos.script: Otávio sends Renata the plan for the quarter. Three features, already chosen. {{title}} It is a clear plan. It also tells the team exactly what to build, and leaves nothing to decide. {{list}} Renata goes back and asks him for the problem instead. Fewer patients who book and never turn up. {{problem}} The team looks at the data, and finds something none of the three features would have touched. {{data}} This lesson is about that trade. Why alignment and autonomy are not two ends of one slider. {{axes}} The three places a plan goes wrong between the people who make it and the people who do it. And why adding detail makes each one worse. {{gaps}} And a list of who decides what. Which decisions can be undone, and which cannot. {{doors}}
